events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius has left an indelible mark on British humour. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles', but universally known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album' – a sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed every facet of their genius. What's your go-to track from this legendary record?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we said goodbye to a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence continue to electrify generations. He would have been 80 this year.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', marking a pivotal shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a turning point, this album showcased their evolving artistry. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world fell silent for John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate. He would have been 86 this year.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, the iconic musician and innovator, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Celebrating the unparalleled artistry and fearless reinvention of David Bowie. What's the Bowie track that means the most to you?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Celebrating the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have marked his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music continues to define generations. What's your favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock God's Birthday
angles.copy: From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your favourite Page guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rocker and crooner Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Still rockin' at 82! Happy birthday to the iconic Sir Rod Stewart. What's your all-time favourite song from his incredible career?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: It's the 66th birthday of the one and only Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing us 'One Step Beyond'. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the voice behind so many 80s classics, Paul Young! What's your favourite track from the 'No Parlez' era?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary country music icon Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to Dolly
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of the incredible Dolly Parton. Her music, her heart, her spirit – truly one of a kind.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That hits to solo success, he's a true British music legend. What's your favourite Gary Barlow song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' – it's Billy Ocean's 77th birthday! The smooth voice behind so many classics. What's your favourite Billy Ocean track?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction! Which legendary artist would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's still got it. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockout
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London. What an unforgettable way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy Award-winning singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins' Birthday
angles.copy: In the air tonight, it's Phil Collins' 76th birthday! A true legend of drums and vocals, from Genesis to his incredible solo career. What's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Birthday
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back for his 46th birthday! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT banger?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Detective Inspector Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure's Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! A very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. From Peckham to CID, what's your favourite of his iconic roles?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Music Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost three music pioneers on 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop sensation Rick Astley, famous for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley's Birthday
angles.copy: Never gonna give him up, never gonna let him down! Happy 61st birthday to the legendary Rick Astley. What's your favourite Rickroll-worthy track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley. His message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.
